source_audit.publisher: Greater London Authority / London City Hall
source_audit.license: GLA website terms; factual metadata and source URLs only until reuse terms are reviewed
source_audit.coverage_years: Current page section inspected for 2020 strategic referral decisions; source family covers mayoral planning-application decisions across multiple years.
source_audit.geographic_scope: Greater London strategic planning referrals under the Mayor of London Order 2008.
source_audit.reliability: strong for mayoral planning-process milestones; not evidence of construction, completion, opening, or built outcome
source_audit.required_caveats: Use as an administrative planning milestone only. Stage 1 and Stage 2 reports can describe proposals and mayoral decisions, but do not prove that works began, completed, opened, or delivered claimed outcomes.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Suitable for selected major London architecture/planning candidate events when paired with duplicate screening and explicit planning-only limitations.

source_audit.publisher: Greater London Authority / Planning London Datahub
source_audit.license: London Datastore dataset page says licence not specified; API documentation provides read-only guest access. Treat as GLA planning-system public data with terms review required before redistribution beyond factual metadata.
source_audit.coverage_years: Rows inspected include applications validated and decided mainly from 2017-2026; coverage is incomplete and varies by LPA/back-office feed.
source_audit.update_frequency: Daily according to London Datastore dataset page.
source_audit.geographic_scope: London planning authority application rows with LPA, reference, description, dates, status, decision, centroid, and sometimes planning-register URL.
source_audit.reliability: usable with caveats; strong for row-level administrative metadata where coordinates are within London, risky where placeholder coordinates or null source URLs appear
source_audit.required_caveats: Centroids can be approximate or erroneous; rows with placeholder coordinates outside London were rejected or replaced with clearly approximate site points. Datahub decision/status fields are administrative and may lag or differ from GLA Stage 2 process dates.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use to enrich GLA decision candidates with LPA application references, dates, and centroids, but keep GLA report PDFs as the public source of the strategic mayoral decision.
